userStories.title: Add validate_config() function to ralph.py
userStories.description: Add a validate_config(cfg: dict) function to ralph.py that checks the config dict for required top-level keys: 'model', 'max_iterations', 'max_tokens'. Returns a list of missing key names (empty list if all present).
acceptanceCriteria: Returns empty list when all required keys are present
Returns list of missing key names when any are absent

userStories.title: Add --validate flag to ralph.py argparse
userStories.description: Add a --validate flag to ralph.py's argparse setup. When invoked, load config.yaml via load_config(), call validate_config() on the result, print 'Config OK' if valid or print each missing key prefixed with 'MISSING: ', then exit with code 0 (valid) or 1 (invalid).
acceptanceCriteria: Prints 'Config OK' when config is valid
Exits 0 on valid config, 1 on invalid
